method: Production Kotlin Bilibili extractor and downloader on desktop JVM; public requests without login cookies. Downloaded files played locally in isolated Chrome with browser sandbox enabled.

playback.method: Isolated Chrome local file playback, no network media, browser sandbox enabled
Isolated Chrome local file playback, no network media, browser sandbox enabled

samples.note: The platform quality label is 720P; the actual older source file decodes at 640 x 360. The app does not infer pixel dimensions from the quality label.

limitations: No Android device or emulator was connected; Android interaction and device-specific playback remain for phone testing.
Accelerated local playback reached the end with audio/video decode and no media error. Dropped-frame counts at accelerated rates are not normal-speed performance evidence.
Results describe these public samples at the recorded time, not all Bilibili videos or all available quality levels.
No signed media URLs, credentials, raw API bodies, downloaded videos, or screenshots are included in the source delivery.
